link_training_waveforms.LT_LFPS: Low-Frequency Periodic Signaling ordered sets for link bring-up + lane bonding.
link_training_waveforms.sideband: SBU low-speed management pulses for connect/lane-config.

power_delivery_timing.CC_negotiation: USB Power Delivery message exchange on CC pins before high-power VBUS.

main_link_waveform.signaling: differential NRZ per lane, AC-coupled, embedded clock.
main_link_waveform.framing: Transfer Units of active video framed by BS/BE control symbols; MSA per frame; secondary-data packets (SS/SE) in blanking.
main_link_waveform.clocking: Sink recovers the embedded clock with a CDR; no dedicated clock lane.

aux_waveform.transaction: SYNC preamble + START + (command[4] + address[20] + length) request, then Sink reply, then STOP.

link_training_waveform.CR_phase: TPS1 on all active lanes; adjust voltage swing / pre-emphasis until CR_DONE.
link_training_waveform.EQ_phase: TPS2/3/4 (or UHBR pattern) until CHANNEL_EQ_DONE + SYMBOL_LOCKED + INTERLANE_ALIGN_DONE.

msa_waveform.msa: Main Stream Attributes sent once per frame in vertical blanking: Mvid/Nvid, Htotal/Vtotal, HSP/HSW, active width/height, MISC0/MISC1.
msa_waveform.purpose: Lets the Sink regenerate the pixel clock from the link clock (asynchronous clocking).

hpd_waveform.irq_hpd: Short pulse (>= ~0.5 ms, <= ~1 ms) signals an event; Source re-reads DPCD.

general_timing_rule: The Main Link unit interval is set by the link rate (e.g. ~123.5 ps UI at 8.1 Gbps HBR3). The embedded clock is recovered per lane during CR; multi-lane links are de-skewed during EQ. The pixel clock is regenerated from Mvid/Nvid. AUX runs at a fixed ~1 Mbps Manchester-II independent of the Main Link rate.

voltage_levels.note: Swing + pre-emphasis selected per lane during CR; bounded combinations.
